evidence.support: Part 5.6 explicitly asks for a marginal-costing reconciliation from budgeted to actual profit, using sales contribution and variable cost variances and fixed cost expenditure variance.

The reconciliation separately computes planning and operational sales-volume variances, matching the descriptor’s distinction between revised-standard planning effects and actual-versus-revised operational effects.
